action_summary: The blind catalogue measured the skill store as contributing nothing and recorded the reason in the same receipt: the learned pattern was one hole over the whole body, so it produced 0 proposals on its own witness, on a held-out same-family body and in file text. This wave replaces the operator rather than the index: anti-unification that parameterises identifiers, a right-hand side that projects the after side out of the bound before side, and three fail-closed gates (fidelity, transfer, non-degeneracy) so a rule that cannot fire on a renamed instance is never stored.
